name: claude-plugins-official
description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.
one_liner: Anthropic's own official storefront listing add-ons for their Claude Code tool, so you don't accidentally install a sketchy one.
buyer: There isn't really an outside buyer here. It's Anthropic's own curated catalog, maintained by Anthropic for Anthropic's product, not infrastructure a third party builds a business on top of.
business_use_cases: A developer submits their own plugin for inclusion in the directory to get free distribution to every Claude Code user.
A company evaluating Claude Code for its engineering team checks this directory first to see which third-party add-ons are vetted enough to trust.
An agency building Claude Code plugins for clients uses the listed structure/schema as the template to follow so their plugin gets accepted.

money_ideas.idea: Build and list a genuinely useful plugin here to get free marketing, then monetize the plugin itself (not the directory) via a paid pro tier.

steal_this: If you already have a useful internal Claude Code workflow, package it as a plugin, submit it to this directory this weekend, and see if the free distribution turns into inbound leads.
